name: indoor-bikini-mirror-selfie
image_purpose: Vacation outfit post and lifestyle feed visual

prompt.project_info: Create a realistic indoor mirror selfie with travel-ready swimwear styling and bright window light.
prompt.main_subject: One approved adult woman taking a mirror selfie with a smartphone in her right hand. She wears the exact blue printed swim top and matching blue bottoms under an orange crochet fringe skirt, carries an oversized black shoulder tote, and keeps a relaxed natural expression and posture.
prompt.composition_elements: Vertical portrait mirror selfie with the subject aligned diagonally through the frame. Include large bright-paned windows, curtains, a neutral interior, reflected greenery, and accurate phone and mirror geometry.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Soft natural daylight through the windows, warm realistic skin tones, gentle shadows on the crochet fringe and tote, relaxed vacation-ready mood.
prompt.technical_specs: Wide-angle smartphone mirror-selfie look, vertical framing, realistic printed fabric, crochet, leather, hair, and window texture, subtle grain, natural color.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: A realistic vertical indoor mirror selfie of one approved adult woman holding a smartphone in her right hand. She wears the exact blue printed swim top and matching blue bottoms under an orange crochet fringe skirt, carries an oversized black shoulder tote, and maintains a relaxed natural posture. Use a diagonal composition with bright-paned windows, curtains, reflected greenery, and a neutral interior behind her. Soft natural daylight, realistic swimwear print, crochet fringe, leather, skin, and window texture, accurate reflection, subtle grain, and travel-ready lifestyle energy.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, nudity, sexualized pose, explicit body-part emphasis, child or teen appearance, celebrity likeness, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, harsh flash, broken reflection, distorted hands, extra fingers, deformed, random text, watermark, low resolution, blur

assets.name: indoor-bikini-mirror-selfie.jpg
assets.source: local approved subject, swimwear, room, and composition reference
assets.usage: Preserve approved adult identity, exact blue print, orange crochet skirt, tote, phone, window, pose, and lighting.

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: Attach the required reference. Preserve identity, outfit, safe mirror pose, tote, phone, environment, reflection, and lighting. Curtains and reflected greenery may be replaced; do not invent logos or typography. Any replacement person must be an approved adult.

changes: Clarified the subject as an approved adult and retained the specified swimwear, crochet styling, and natural mirror-selfie composition without added sexualized wording.
